acceleration_note: 3 g equivalent static comparison envelope, chosen for screening; not measured G1 motion or impact
material_note: Generic isotropic solid polymer comparison assumption. No measured printed-material qualification.
support_note: Both nominal flat top seat patches z=0 around the two M4 axes fully clamped; ideal screw/head interface, not actual preload/contact
joint_note: Carrier-to-bracket shared face perfectly bonded in primary whole-assembly comparison; real M3 joint compliance and slip excluded
payload_reference_note: Relative to rail longitudinal center and bracket coordinate; +X front. Actual camera lens/COM unknown. Identical load eccentricity relative to carrier across candidates.
selection_policy: Select lowest-volume forward candidate with at least 30% reduction of worst displacement vs forward_plain and no direction worse; if none, retain best Pareto option with explicit limitations. Verify selected and forward_plain at finer mesh.
